notes.normalization: Single-line strings; no trailing semicolon unless idiomatic for SQL.
notes.liq_join: v0 liq has no JOIN; liq_2step counts two compile units (documented in scenario notes).
notes.vector: Stub — pgvector SQL vs proposed liq extension (PH-DB-7).

scenarios.safety_note: All surfaces parameterized or builder-typed; raw SQL needs allowlist validator.

queries.sql: SELECT id, name, description, created_at FROM public.packages ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 20
queries.liq: read packages { id, name, description, created_at } order name asc limit 20
queries.prisma: await prisma.packages.findMany({ take: 20, orderBy: { name: 'asc' }, select: { id: true, name: true, description: true, createdAt: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.select({ id: packages.id, name: packages.name, description: packages.description, createdAt: packages.createdAt }).from(packages).orderBy(asc(packages.name)).limit(20)
queries.graphql: query { packages(limit: 20, order_by: { name: asc }) { id name description created_at } }

scenarios.intent: Resolve package by name + semver version (single row)
scenarios.safety_note: Name/version must be bound params, not interpolated.

queries.sql: SELECT pv.id, pv.version, pv.tree_digest, pv.proof_digest, pv.coverage_pct FROM public.package_versions pv INNER JOIN public.packages p ON p.id = pv.package_id WHERE p.name = $1 AND pv.version = $2 LIMIT 1
queries.liq: read package_versions { id, version, tree_digest, proof_digest, coverage_pct } where package_id = $pkg and version = $ver limit 1
queries.prisma: await prisma.packageVersion.findFirst({ where: { version: ver, package: { name: pkgName } }, select: { id: true, version: true, treeDigest: true, proofDigest: true, coveragePct: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.select({ id: packageVersions.id, version: packageVersions.version, treeDigest: packageVersions.treeDigest }).from(packageVersions).innerJoin(packages, eq(packages.id, packageVersions.packageId)).where(and(eq(packages.name, pkgName), eq(packageVersions.version, ver))).limit(1)
queries.graphql: query($n:String!,$v:String!){ package_versions(where:{package:{name:{_eq:$n}},version:{_eq:$v}},limit:1){ id version tree_digest proof_digest coverage_pct } }

scenarios.intent: Insert package_version + attestation row (publish gate fields)
scenarios.safety_note: liq/ORM bind values; SQL uses $n placeholders only.

queries.sql: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO public.package_versions (package_id, version, tree_digest, proof_digest, coverage_pct, publisher_id) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING id) INSERT INTO public.attestations (package_version_id, kind, digest, signature) SELECT id, $7, $8, $9 FROM ins RETURNING id
queries.liq: insert package_versions { package_id: $pkg, version: $ver, tree_digest: $tree, proof_digest: $proof, coverage_pct: $cov, publisher_id: $pub }
queries.prisma: await prisma.$transaction([prisma.packageVersion.create({ data: { packageId, version, treeDigest, proofDigest, coveragePct, publisherId } }), prisma.attestation.create({ data: { packageVersionId, kind, digest, signature } })])
queries.drizzle: db.transaction(async (tx) => { const [pv] = await tx.insert(packageVersions).values({ packageId, version, treeDigest, proofDigest, coveragePct, publisherId }).returning({ id: packageVersions.id }); await tx.insert(attestations).values({ packageVersionId: pv.id, kind, digest, signature }); })
queries.supabase_js: const { data: pv } = await supabase.from('package_versions').insert({ package_id, version, tree_digest, proof_digest, coverage_pct, publisher_id }).select('id').single(); await supabase.from('attestations').insert({ package_version_id: pv.id, kind, digest, signature })

scenarios.intent: Multi-table join publisher + package by package name
scenarios.safety_note: liq v0: no JOIN — liq_2step is honest agent workaround.

queries.sql: SELECT pkg.id, pkg.name, pub.id AS publisher_id, pub.name AS publisher_name FROM public.packages pkg INNER JOIN public.publishers pub ON pub.id = pkg.publisher_id WHERE pkg.name = $1 LIMIT 1
queries.liq: read packages { id, name, publisher_id } where name = $pkg limit 1
queries.liq_2step: read packages { id, name, publisher_id } where name = $pkg limit 1 | read publishers { id, name } where id = $pub limit 1
queries.prisma: await prisma.package.findFirst({ where: { name: pkgName }, include: { publisher: { select: { id: true, name: true } } } })
queries.drizzle: db.select({ packageId: packages.id, packageName: packages.name, publisherName: publishers.name }).from(packages).innerJoin(publishers, eq(publishers.id, packages.publisherId)).where(eq(packages.name, pkgName)).limit(1)
queries.graphql: query($n:String!){ packages(where:{name:{_eq:$n}},limit:1){ id name publisher { id name } } }

scenarios.intent: Tenant-scoped read under RLS (JWT publisher claim)
scenarios.safety_note: RLS enforced server-side; client must not bypass with raw SQL strings.

queries.sql: SELECT id, name, created_at FROM public.publishers WHERE id = current_setting('request.jwt.claim.publisher_id', true)::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
queries.liq: read publishers { id, name, created_at } where id = $publisher_id order created_at desc limit 20
queries.prisma: await prisma.publisher.findMany({ where: { id: session.publisherId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 20, select: { id: true, name: true, createdAt: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.select({ id: publishers.id, name: publishers.name, createdAt: publishers.createdAt }).from(publishers).where(eq(publishers.id, publisherId)).orderBy(desc(publishers.createdAt)).limit(20)
queries.graphql: query { publishers(limit: 20, order_by: { created_at: desc }) { id name created_at } }

scenarios.intent: List agent_runs ordered by started_at (agent dashboard)
scenarios.safety_note: Prefer liq MCP allowlist over free-form SQL for agents.

queries.sql: SELECT run_id, agent_id, status, started_at, briefing_hash FROM public.agent_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20
queries.liq: read agent_runs { run_id, agent_id, status, started_at, briefing_hash } order started_at desc limit 20
queries.prisma: await prisma.agentRun.findMany({ orderBy: { startedAt: 'desc' }, take: 20, select: { runId: true, agentId: true, status: true, startedAt: true, briefingHash: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.select({ runId: agentRuns.runId, agentId: agentRuns.agentId, status: agentRuns.status, startedAt: agentRuns.startedAt }).from(agentRuns).orderBy(desc(agentRuns.startedAt)).limit(20)
queries.supabase_js: const { data } = await supabase.from('agent_runs').select('run_id,agent_id,status,started_at,briefing_hash').order('started_at', { ascending: false, nullsFirst: false }).limit(20)
queries.graphql: query { agent_runs(limit: 20, order_by: { started_at: desc_nulls_last }) { run_id agent_id status started_at briefing_hash } }

scenarios.intent: Top-K ANN on embedding column (registry artifact index stub)
scenarios.safety_note: Vector literal must be param/array bind; never string-concat SQL.

queries.sql: SELECT id, package_version_id, kind FROM public.attestations ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT 10
queries.liq: read attestations { id, package_version_id, kind } similar $vec limit 10
queries.prisma: await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT id, package_version_id, kind FROM attestations ORDER BY embedding <=> ${vec}::vector LIMIT 10`
queries.drizzle: sql`SELECT id, package_version_id, kind FROM attestations ORDER BY embedding <=> ${vec}::vector LIMIT 10`

scenarios.intent: Record yank for a package version
scenarios.safety_note: Mutations require capability token in lidb; agents use liq insert not raw SQL.

queries.sql: INSERT INTO public.yanks (package_version_id, reason, yanked_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (package_version_id) DO UPDATE SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason, yanked_at = now() RETURNING id
queries.prisma: await prisma.yank.upsert({ where: { packageVersionId }, create: { packageVersionId, reason, yankedBy }, update: { reason } })
queries.drizzle: db.insert(yanks).values({ packageVersionId, reason, yankedBy }).onConflictDoUpdate({ target: yanks.packageVersionId, set: { reason } }).returning({ id: yanks.id })

scenarios.intent: Agent schema snapshot for tool planning (compact catalog)
scenarios.safety_note: MCP returns fixed markdown/JSON; not user-composed SQL.

queries.sql: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = ANY($1) ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position
queries.prisma: const cols = await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = ${table}`
queries.graphql: query { __type(name: "agent_runs") { fields { name type { name kind } } } }

scenarios.intent: Keyset pagination on package_versions by (published_at, id)
scenarios.safety_note: Cursor values must be bound; opaque cursor encoding recommended.

queries.sql: SELECT id, package_id, version, published_at FROM public.package_versions WHERE (published_at, id) < ($1, $2) ORDER BY published_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50
queries.liq: read package_versions { id, package_id, version, published_at } where published_at < $cursor_ts and id < $cursor_id order published_at desc limit 50
queries.prisma: await prisma.packageVersion.findMany({ take: 50, cursor: { id: cursorId }, skip: 1, orderBy: [{ publishedAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }] })

scenarios.intent: All versions for one package id

queries.sql: SELECT id, version, published_at, yanked FROM public.package_versions WHERE package_id = $1 ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 100
queries.liq: read package_versions { id, version, published_at, yanked } where package_id = $pkg order published_at desc limit 100
queries.prisma: await prisma.packageVersion.findMany({ where: { packageId }, orderBy: { publishedAt: 'desc' }, take: 100 })

scenarios.safety_note: liq update requires filter; prevents table-wide updates.

queries.sql: UPDATE public.publishers SET display_name = $1 WHERE id = $2 RETURNING id, display_name
queries.liq: update publishers set display_name = $name where id = $id returning id, display_name
queries.prisma: await prisma.publisher.update({ where: { id }, data: { displayName: name }, select: { id: true, displayName: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.update(publishers).set({ displayName: name }).where(eq(publishers.id, id)).returning({ id: publishers.id, displayName: publishers.displayName })

scenarios.safety_note: Pattern must not be built from unescaped user regex.

queries.sql: SELECT id, package_name, tree_digest, reason FROM public.blocklist WHERE package_name = $1 LIMIT 5
queries.liq: read blocklist { id, package_name, tree_digest, reason } where package_name = $name limit 5
queries.prisma: await prisma.blocklist.findMany({ where: { packageName: name }, take: 5 })

scenarios.safety_note: liq v0 lacks GROUP BY — agents use SQL capability or MCP aggregate tool.

queries.sql: SELECT status, count(*)::bigint AS n FROM public.agent_runs GROUP BY status ORDER BY n DESC
queries.graphql: query { agent_runs_aggregate { group_by { status } aggregate { count } } }

scenarios.intent: Insert new agent_run row at start of run
scenarios.safety_note: Control-plane writes via service role only in production.

queries.sql: INSERT INTO public.agent_runs (run_id, agent_id, status, started_at, briefing_hash) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now(), $4) RETURNING id, run_id
queries.liq: insert agent_runs { run_id: $run_id, agent_id: $agent_id, status: $status, briefing_hash: $hash }
queries.prisma: await prisma.agentRun.create({ data: { runId, agentId, status, briefingHash, startedAt: new Date() }, select: { id: true, runId: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.insert(agentRuns).values({ runId, agentId, status, briefingHash, startedAt: sql`now()` }).returning({ id: agentRuns.id, runId: agentRuns.runId })
queries.supabase_js: await supabase.from('agent_runs').insert({ run_id, agent_id, status, briefing_hash }).select('id,run_id').single()

queries.sql: SELECT id, kind, digest, created_at FROM public.attestations WHERE package_version_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
queries.liq: read attestations { id, kind, digest, created_at } where package_version_id = $pvid order created_at asc
queries.prisma: await prisma.attestation.findMany({ where: { packageVersionId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })

scenarios.intent: Soft yank via boolean on package_versions (alternative to yanks table)
scenarios.safety_note: Prefer dedicated yanks table + liq insert for audit trail.

queries.sql: UPDATE public.package_versions SET yanked = true WHERE id = $1 AND publisher_id = $2 RETURNING id, version, yanked
queries.liq: update package_versions set yanked = true where id = $pvid and publisher_id = $pub returning id, version, yanked
queries.prisma: await prisma.packageVersion.update({ where: { id, publisherId }, data: { yanked: true } })
queries.drizzle: db.update(packageVersions).set({ yanked: true }).where(and(eq(packageVersions.id, pvid), eq(packageVersions.publisherId, pub))).returning({ id: packageVersions.id, version: packageVersions.version, yanked: packageVersions.yanked })
queries.supabase_js: await supabase.from('package_versions').update({ yanked: true }).match({ id: pvid, publisher_id: pub }).select('id,version,yanked').single()
